test: Code reading of CouplingCalculations.cs and SpreadsheetIO.cs; MATLAB on-path gain vs the C# offset rule on three hand cases
key_result: Convention matches: both take the takeoff angle from the local horizontal, positive up, and use takeoff - tilt; on three hand cases MATLAB minus the C# rule is at most 1.9e-12 dB.
